title: Patient Outcome Reporting for Timely Assessments of Life With Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
official: Patient Outcome Reporting for Timely Assessments of Life With Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
summary: This study aims to implement and evaluate a more timely approach to post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) diagnosis and management, entitled Patient Outcome Reporting for Timely Assessments of Life with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PORTAL-PTSD) in a primary care setting with a high prevalence of trauma, specifically the South Side of Chicago, in partnership with Chicago Family Health Center (CFHC).
criteria:
Patient Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 years
* Had an appointment at the study site in the last 24 months
* Were not screened for PTSD in the last 12 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
